paragraphs.text: A planar barrier is a magical way to prevent planeswalkers or other beings from traveling to (or leaving) certain planes . Planar barriers can be created on purpose by planeswalkers, powerful wizards , or other powerful beings. They can also be the result of cosmological events. Given the reduced capabilities of planeswalkers in the post-mending Omenpath era, it is unclear how planar barriers have been affected and if they can be created in the future.
